title: Peak Product Stretch
commonMistakes: Keeping only the maximum ending product
Forgetting to consider the current element by itself
Overwriting the previous maximum before computing the new minimum
Skipping zero values without considering them as valid stretches
followUps: How would you return the start and end indices of a best stretch?
What changes if the sequence contains floating-point values?
How would you find the maximum product of a stretch with at most `k` negative values?
